description: Every screen of the classic 18.6.6 interface and where its React rebuild stands (ADR 0014), re-homed under the client-first hierarchy (ADR 0015): a rebuilt research step lives at /app/clients/<client>/research/<id>/<stage>, <id> being the AIA study. `aia_screens` lists the client-first screens that have no classic counterpart. The routes are the ones its router knows, parsed from ui_app.html by tools/ui_workbench/capture.mjs routesFrom() (aliases folded: demo->home, sociomap->visualization, production->home, fullsim->sim_context); the DEMO views are one per collection with their tabs. A screen is REBUILT only with its capture pair in the workbench and its tests.

statuses.CLASSIC: served by the frozen unit at /classic, an explicit hand-off, skinned (ADR 0013, ADR 0015)
statuses.REBUILDING: a React screen exists under /app but does not yet carry everything the classic one shows
statuses.REBUILT: the React screen carries every label, control and state of the classic one; capture pair and tests

screens.title: Správa projektů
screens.notes: Trash view at /app/projects/trash. Open, new research/simulation and the portfolio dashboard hand off to the classic interface (ADR 0014 decision 7). Capture pair: 0 classic texts missing at 1440 and 1024. Status tones split running / waiting-on-you / waiting-on-the-world, which 18.6.6 paints alike.

screens.title: 1. Zadání
screens.notes: Also /app/research/<id>/brief. The analysis job hands on to /app/research/<id>/plan. Capture pair: 0 classic texts missing at 1440 and 1024. Differences are listed in .planning/plans/research-flow-rehome.md: the provider notice stays on the screen, the error card says what failed, one button uploads, a new project says it is not saved yet.

screens.title: 2. Návrh
screens.notes: Captured on the `planned` fixture beside the classic step opened on the same project (#aia:open=<id>@plan): 0 classic texts missing at 1440 and 1024. The review note (1785) and the "Další krok: dotazník" card are not drawn, because the classic comment wrapper (26) removes both. Differences are listed in .planning/plans/research-flow-rehome.md.

screens.title: 3. Dotazník
screens.notes: Captured on the `questionnaire` fixture beside the classic step opened on the same project: 1 classic text missing at 1440 and 1024, "AI: zlepšit blok", left out on purpose because it does nothing in the classic interface (OI-49). The choose, upload and AI views are covered by QuestionnaireStep.test.tsx. Differences are listed in .planning/plans/research-flow-rehome.md.

screens.title: 4. Audience / Cílová skupina
screens.notes: Captured on the `audience` fixture (ČR 18+, narrowed) beside the classic step on the same project: 1 classic text missing at 1440 and 1024, "[object Object]", the classic summary's print of a range, drawn "25–54" instead. The other branches (own, special, coming soon) are covered by AudienceStep.test.tsx. OI-50 and OI-51 are kept as the classic behaves.

screens.title: 5. Dimenze
screens.notes: Captured on the `persona` fixture (three catalogue dimensions, one request, N=450) beside the classic step on the same project: 0 classic texts missing at 1440 and 1024. The AI suggestion, the requests, the sample and a failed catalogue are covered by PersonaStep.test.tsx. OI-53 and OI-54 are kept as the classic behaves; OI-57 is not reproduced (one catalogue request).

screens.title: 6. Finální kontrola & spuštění
screens.notes: The AIA run stage (ADR 0016): the design the person sees is submitted as a Design Revision, AIA's structural readiness checks are shown, and one run starts over that revision through /api/v1/studies/<study>/research/runs. Not the classic stage: its single AI check and the 18.6.6 technical preflight are not carried; they stay in /classic.

screens.title: Výzkum probíhá
screens.notes: The AIA progress stage (ADR 0016): the run's canonical state, step by step, with the explicit wait for the AI runtime at fieldwork; cancel and retry. Reads AIA's API only.

screens.title: 7. Výsledky
screens.notes: The AIA results stage (ADR 0016): the run's aggregate (suppression and intervals) and its INTERNAL_ONLY Sociomap, each with provenance; fictional data is labelled on every view. The 18.6.6 analytical report stays in /classic (the stage links to it).

aia_screens.title: Klienti
aia_screens.notes: The application home: the clients the caller holds a grant in.
